coder_notes: Arm labels contain colons; labels taken as the text before the arm description (e.g. 'Phase 1 part: Dose Finding'). Temozolomide is a registered intervention only in the Phase 2b/IIb arms but the Phase 1 and Phase 2 arm descriptions state standard TMZ chemoradiotherapy, so all four arms listed. Registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR arm exists; no OTHER/EXPERIMENTAL arm acts as control.
